title: Pullback preserves K-flat complexes
statement: Let $f:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-pc-scheme]. If $K^\bullet$ is a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], then the pulled-back complex $f^*K^\bullet$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_X$.
